description: A kneeling, bare-chested man with long black hair and a shell necklace sits at the mouth of a rock cave, pressing small pale seeds into a patch of dirt. A pale gourd bowl and a flat stone slab with plant fragments lie beside him. Cave walls with faint pictographs frame the scene, and a dry desert valley with shrubs and mountains is visible through the entrance. The painting is an oil-style image that fills the canvas edge to edge, with no visible text.
